subtitle: The Unheard Order

briefing.text: The old current-map points beneath the willow. Get Orra through the downstream landing and return to the divided company.
The retreat orders left Orra’s detachment cut off at the worksite. Reach the downstream landing through the lower channel. The Mother’s roots are spreading across the bank.

hints: Water offers a route the woodland guards cannot follow. Harpoons can strike thornshields without touching their thorns.

intro.text: Captain Mares ordered the retreat. His two crew chiefs each thought the other would warn us. Now we are the ones left on this bank.
The downstream landing is still clear. We can swim the lower channel before her guards close it.
Then we get back to the company. I mean to command more than whoever happens to hear me shout.

victory.text: The map shows a spring still worth keeping. If Mares cannot make his crews act together, I will.

debrief: Orra returns to the rear camp with a route through the inlet and a current-map leading toward the willow. The spring is still in the Mother’s hands.
